verdict.rationale: cubic lets developers ask natural-language questions about code: selecting code and choosing "Add to AI chat" uses the diff and codebase as context, and PR comment threads accept follow-up questions and clarification requests. Coding agents can also read and triage review findings over MCP. However, these conversations are framed around understanding and reviewing PR changes, not open-ended debugging of runtime issues. missing for 10: documented debugging/troubleshooting workflows (e.g., investigating errors, logs or failing behavior via natural language), chat usable outside the PR review context, independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat's troubleshooting usefulness.
